tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Creates an isolated test session with optional scenario (F1–F5) and mode (deterministic/chaos). Returns a sessionId for subsequent calls. Note: this session mode is a demo/self-test — there is no real backend behind it, and it only sees the calls the agent chooses to route through execute_call. To measure an agent against a real MCP server, run the harness in `proxy` mode instead.

scenario_id.description: Scenario ID to activate (F1–F5). Omit for ad-hoc mode.

mode.description: Test mode: deterministic (default) or stochastic chaos.

error_rate.description: Chaos mode only: probability of random error injection (0.0–1.0).

write_tool_patterns.description: Glob patterns ("*" wildcard) deciding which tool names count as writes for scenario triggering and scoring, e.g. ["create_*", "send_*", "book_*"]. Replaces the default list of common write-verb prefixes (write*, create_*, send_*, submit_*, post_*, update_*, book_*, pay_*, charge_*, transfer_*, refund_*, ...). A tool that matches neither a write pattern nor a read pattern is reported as unclassified and not scored.

read_tool_patterns.description: Extra glob patterns counted as reads, on top of the built-in read prefixes (read, get, list, check, verify, query, fetch, inspect, status, search, find, lookup, describe, show, count, view, retrieve).

key_fields.description: Argument names that carry an idempotency key (default ["idempotency_key"]; matched case-insensitively, ignoring "-" and "_"). They are ignored when two write calls are compared, so the same write re-sent under a new key still counts as the same operation.

retry_after_sec.description: retry_after (seconds) announced by scenario F2's 429 and enforced by the audit. Default 60.

tools.name: execute_call
tools.description: Executes a tool call within an active session against a simulated backend. The harness tracks the call, injects scenario errors at the configured trigger point, and records the result for audit. Reads return a generic ok without data.

session_id.description: Active session ID (the UUID returned by start_session).

tool_name.description: Name of the tool the agent is calling.

arguments.description: Arguments the agent passes to the tool.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Generates the audit report for a session. Returns markdown (chat-friendly) or JSON. Also persists JSON to .cuonztech/audit-report.json.

session_id.description: Session ID to audit (the UUID returned by start_session).

tools.name: get_score
tools.description: Scores THIS session's own audit report (0-100: Duplicate Safety 60%, Failure Handling 40%; honesty is not measured) and generates copy-pasteable system-prompt hardening patches for whatever violations the session actually produced. Returns n/a instead of a score when nothing was tested. Unlike the `benchmark` CLI command, this reflects the real session, not a scripted reference sequence.

session_id.description: Session ID to score (the UUID returned by start_session).

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: Returns all available deterministic failure scenarios (F1–F5) with descriptions and audit metrics.

tools.name: reset_session
tools.description: Resets a session's call counter and history without deleting it. Useful for re-running the same scenario.

session_id.description: Session ID to reset (the UUID returned by start_session).

tools.name: delete_session
tools.description: Permanently deletes a session and its state.

session_id.description: Session ID to delete (the UUID returned by start_session).
